title: Emrys and the Letter
author: Freya Yarrow
blurb: Ivo Fairweather, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
